raw.rationale: To prepare for a career as a data engineer constructing modern machine learning pipelines, this plan focuses on data systems and machine intelligence. CSC 675 provides core expertise in database design, querying, and data management essential for ETL and data pipelines. CSC 665 and CSC 671 supply the mathematical and algorithmic groundwork for deploying and training machine learning and deep learning models. Finally, CSC 603 and CSC 620 provide specialized knowledge in large language models, generative AI architectures, and natural language technologies directly aligned with modern pipeline development.

electiveChoices.reason: Provides foundational knowledge in database architecture, indexing, and SQL essential for designing robust data engineering pipelines.
Covers essential AI and machine learning techniques necessary to understand models deployed across data pipelines.
Teaches deep neural network structures and training dynamics, key for building and orchestrating deep learning workflows.
Focuses on the fundamentals and applications of generative AI systems, directly aligning with engineering pipelines for modern foundation models.
Develops specialized competence in natural language processing and token pipelines required for language model ingestion and deployment.
